P05 trigger (§2): two accepted corrections with the same target meet at the same fourth-order node, T4-013: OnePiece-012 ('people thought the fixing of it was attempted vandalism. I... actively worked against fixing the jaw') and leagueoflegends-053 ('If someone would stop patching up the white glare'). portugal-029 (T4-019) and monsterhunter-016 (T4-007, 'whoever fixes the potion keeps undoing my work') meet it in substance. Target: P05's 'members watch it and repair changed pixels', which takes repair to restore the work; in these rooms repair restored the form its keepers knew and undid a valid fix, an intended feature or an agreed change. This is the same mechanism P02's lines showed in 14 rooms from the other side. P05 is re-examined in this leg; I read its remaining lines first and write the revision, if the alignment holds, at the group's close
